svg.text: Scheduled Jobs: Hermes Works While You Sleep
Instead of you asking, the agent runs a prompt on a timer and sends you the result.

g.text: A saved prompt plus a schedule. At
the set time Hermes runs it as a full
agent turn — skills, search and all.
day, every month, any day of week day, every month, every weekday —#8212;
i.e. 9:00 AM daily. Next run: Oct 3.
Results go to a messaging channel,
so the digest lands on your phone.
Pause or Trigger now to test it.
Bots answer when asked. Scheduled jobs + messaging turn Hermes into an assistant that reaches out to you, on its own schedule.
